chapters.title: Chapter 1 - 01 - Finally, freedom!
paragraphs: "Long Qingyi, my only disciple, I need you to remember my teachings." An ancient voice echoed through a small hut.
The owner of that voice was sitting on a stone pedestal, his aged hands pressed the back of a young man.
"That bloodline will try to corrupt you, it will promise you the power to dominate all affinities and..." The old man paused, scratching his chin.
"All the beauties in the world..." He concluded, turning his flushed face away.
"But never fall prey to these temptations. Don’t give in to these seductive words." He put some more strength into his voice.
"I’ve abandoned the path of cultivation and so must you. I know it’s difficult, but you must sacrifice your future for the good of the world."
He continued, not noticing Qingyi’s expression darkening at every word.
"Keep your chastity intact and, when you are ready to leave this world, find a worthy disciple, willing to follow this path and prevent this profane bloodline from falling into the wrong hands."
"Yes, master, I will not let you down and I will not allow the world to be corrupted!" Qingyi spoke, his tone was pure and gentle, drawing a smile from the old man.
He had really found an admirable disciple.
Thinking for a brief moment, the old man shook his head.
He wanted to train Qingyi more, to allow his esteemed disciple to reach at least the foundation realm before forcing him to abandon everything, but time was running out.
On the verge of death, he needed to transfer his bloodline and constitution as soon as possible.
"Let’s begin. It will hurt a little, but you have to be strong." The old man said
"I will be strong, master!" Qingyi nodded.
In the next instant, the young man felt the cold, wrinkled hands on his back warm up.
Suddenly, his cultivation of the sixth stage of the Qi refinement realm shattered and every cell in his body screamed in agony.
Qingyi tried to open his mouth, he wanted to scream and cry, but he couldn’t.
The Qi in the room exploded, the ground shook and his body levitated, all the old master’s power flowing into him.
"Stay conscious, don’t faint!" His master’s thunderous voice pulled him out of the pain and he clenched his teeth, resisting with all his strength.
Hours passed until the air around him calmed down and he collapsed on the floor.
"Crap..." Qingyi groaned as he stood up.
He soon noticed his clothes tightening around his body, almost tearing.
With a sigh, he looked outside the hut.
They had started the in the afternoon, but it was already dawn the next day.
Turning around, Qingyi came across the motionless body of his old master. His eyes were open, but empty, with no sign of breathing on his chest.
Hesitating briefly, Qingyi picked up a stick from the ground.
"Master... are you alive?" he poked the corpse with the stick, first in the chest and then in the face.
He pressed a little harder and felt his heart shudder as the old man’s body toppled backwards.
"He’s dead..." Qingyi covered his mouth, his face overcome with shock before bursting into uncontrollable laughter.
"Fucking finally! I’m free!" He roared, wiping away the tears that had built up in his eyes. Twelve years of suffering were finally over!
His life was worse than living on the streets or being an office worker on Earth, working like a slave and living under constant surveillance.
That damned old man even came close to castrating him just because he had looked at a senior sister a few moments too long!
Qingyi was only ten years old at the time! How on earth could that old man see malice in a child’s gaze at his gentle older sister?!
Just because his eyes were on those huge tits didn’t mean he was a pervert! Where else could he look?
Those behemoths were massive! Not even the best implants in his past life were as perfect as her natural breasts!
Qingyi had to spend months trying to prove to his master that he was a pure young man, not a perverted transmigrant from another world.
It was hard work, he suffered a lot, but it was worth every effort.
Standing up, he examined his reflection in a bronze mirror.
’God... I’m even more handsome than the master told me I would be!’ he exclaimed mentally.
He had grown more than twenty centimeters, reaching a height of one meter ninety. His eyes took on a sharp look, and his face, although undeniably masculine, displayed delicate features.
His dark eyes matched with the black hair that now reached his shoulders. Underneath his clothes, he found powerful sculpted muscles.
Qingyi wasn’t ugly before the bloodline transfer ritual, but now, he displayed a beauty that would dominate any woman’s heart with a single smile.
With a confident smile, Qingyi glanced between his pants, admiring the size of what he found.
"It’s almost doubled in size!" he thought in amazement.
Walking excitedly, he changed his clothes, putting on a pure white cloak, like his master’s.
He wanted to change that color, but all the clothes in that hut were like that, some nonsense that his master used to say: "pure men should only wear white."
Qingyi carefully collected everything he thought was useful and prepared to leave the hut.
Before leaving, however, he looked at the old man’s body.
The corpse was in a strange position, fallen from the platform where they were sitting, with its head pressed against the ground, its back on the platform and its bottom raised high.
"I should give him a proper burial..." he sighed before grabbing the body, trying to move it.
"Ugh... why is this bastard so heavy?" He complained after a few unsuccessful attempts.
He then felt the aged flesh give way under his fingers and quickly stepped back, disgusted.
Although his master had died just that night, his body appeared to have been decomposing for days.
With an expression of revulsion, Qingyi shook his head.
He had only made matters worse.
The old man was now completely on the floor, face down, his face sinking into the damp boards while his bent knees suggestively raised his bottom.
"Ugh... I think it’ll do..." Qingyi fought the nausea and simply picked up a blanket, throwing it over his master’s body as he looked away.
"This disciple thanks the master for all his teachings." He clenched his fists in a respectful gesture before leaving.
When he took a step out of the hut, Qingyi was greeted by two translucent screens carrying texts in a strange language, but which he seemed to be able to understand perfectly.
Observing them, he smiled. His suffering was finally over...
[Blood of the corruption dragon god identified in your body.]
[Do you wish to activate the lust system and begin your journey of conquest and corruption?]

chapters.title: Chapter 2 - 02 - Mo Feixue (01)
paragraphs: It was a hot morning, and Qingyi walked along a narrow dirt track, surrounded by a lush forest.
His cultivation level had dropped two stages during the bloodline transfer ritual, but that didn’t bother him, his handsome face flashing a smile whenever he gazed at the screen in front of his eyes.
[Lust system accepted, starting integration process...]
[Integration process at 80%...]
[Integration process complete.]
Qingyi stopped his steps.
[Welcome to the Lust system, host. Do you wish to begin your path towards eternal glory?"]
"Yes!" he replied without hesitation.
[Name: Long Qingyi
Age: 18
Cultivation: Fourth stage of the Qi refinement realm (10 lust points to improve)
Affinities: Lightning: 30 - Sword: 10 - Charm: 1000 (can be upgraded in the lust store)
Spiritual roots: Fifth level lightning spiritual root (50 lust points to upgrade, new roots can be bought in the lust store).
Bloodline: Blood of the corruption dragon god (Common grade, 100 lust points to upgrade.)
Constitution: Body of the primordial dragon (Common grade, 100 lust points to improve)
Lust points: 100]
"My system..." Qingyi murmured as he passed his fingers across the translucent screen, feeling his skin tingle.
After all the suffering he had been through, after all the humiliation, he could finally have his reward.
’System...’ he called out in his mind, ’what are lust points?’
The next moment, a feminine, robotic voice echoed in his mind.
[Lust points are the system’s main currency. They can be used to cultivate and buy items in the lust store].
’Hm... how can I get them?’

[Lust points are obtained in various ways, such as obscene acts, corruption of pure women and by turning arrogant young masters into cuckolds. The amount of points earned varies according to the power, status and beauty of these women].
"Hm..." Qingyi thought for a moment.
It really was an incredible system. How on earth could his master refuse something so wonderful?
Was he an idiot?
As he pondered this, Qingyi remembered the virtuous and dense heroes of many books he had read on earth.
Yes, there really were such people, and his master was probably one of them.
"Good meat only falls into the lap of the vegetarian..." he sighed at length, but then broke into a smile.
That had been a blessing for him and now that the damned old man was dead, he was free to do whatever he wanted.
So, he continued his journey along the trail, a little aimlessly.
He was still thinking about his next steps when he noticed a carriage standing by the side of the path.
Its wheel was detached while a chubby man tried to fix it.
"Ah... Young taoist!" He shouted to Qingyi, waving his hands.
"Can you help me with this?" The chubby man asked, standing up with a grunt.
"Hm..." Qingyi hesitated briefly, but then nodded. There would be no harm in helping out a little, right?
"Thank you, young Taoist! I’m Mo Tianran, it’s a pleasure to meet you!" Mo Tianran smiled radiantly as he extended his hand to Qingyi.
"I’m Qingyi," Qingyi replied, shaking Tianran’s hand.
"What are you doing in this isolated place, Mu Tianran?" He looked around, sensing a presence inside the carriage, but unable to distinguish it clearly.
"Well... we’re from the Mo family of the Serene Moonlight City. I’m taking my little sister to meet her fiancé, a young master from the Yang family in Golden Cloud City."
"Oh... I understand." Qingyi picked up the carriage wheel.
It was big and heavy, but strangely, it felt light in his hands.
"Golden Cloud City... isn’t that where the Ascending Dragon Sect is?" he asked, vaguely remembering that name.
If the amount of points he earned depended on a woman’s power and beauty, what better place to find powerful beauties than a Sect?
"Has young Taoist Qingyi ever been to Golden Cloud City?" Tianran raised his face in surprise.
"Not really, I’ve only heard my master mention it. He said that the Ascending Dragon Sect is the most powerful in the region."
"Oh... it’s a magnificent place," commented Tianran. "I hear the Sect is open for recruitment. Many young cultivators are rushing to join..."
Tianran paused for a moment, a proud smile lighting up his face: "Not to brag, but my little sister’s future husband is already an inner disciple there. He is already in the Foundation realm!"
"I see..." Qingyi smiled and together, they grabbed the carriage.
Tianran was a cultivator of the third stage of Qi refinement, so lifting the vehicle and putting the wheel back in place was no difficult task.
Just then, a sharp, angry roar sounded from inside the carriage and a little woman appeared.
"Tianran! I told you not to disturb my sleep - oh..." The moment she stepped out of the vehicle, the little woman who owned that voice screamed.
Her feet went straight through the step and she was thrown to the ground.
"Feixue’er!" Tianran roared, but had no time to act.
Luckily, Qingyi was already below her, arms outstretched to catch the little beauty.
"Mm~~" a muffled moan escaped the young girl’s delicate lips as she was wrapped in his arms, landing comfortably against his chest.
She was a youthful beauty, with long red hair, her skin was white, as pure white as jade, with a round, graceful face.
Her delicate body had few curves, her tight Qipao hugging every inch of her figure, falling between her thighs and revealing her white, pure skin.
High white stockings hugged her legs, ending at her thighs, squeezing the plump flesh into a fluffy mound.
"Are you okay?" asked Qingyi with a gentle smile on his handsome, masculine face.
His left hand sank into the young woman’s delicate thighs, the soft flesh, spilling out between his fingers, while his right rested on the pale, flat, mounds on her chest with a gentle squeeze.
[You touched a noble girl indecently in front of her older brother, +2 lust points.]
[Remember that lust points can be exchanged for cultivation levels and items in the lust store].
[Mo Feixue’s Corruption increased by 2 points, +1 lust points].
[Mo Feixue’s Lust increased by 10%].
[Name: Mo Feixue
Age: 19
Corruption: 2/100
Chastity: Intact
Lust: 10%
Talent: Low
Reward: Low
Cultivation: Second stage of the Qi refinement realm.
Traits: lustful, unfaithful, arrogant, elastic-throated, spoiled brat].

chapters.title: Chapter 3 - 03 - Mo Feixue (02)
paragraphs: Mo Feixue was sinking into Long Qingyi’s arms.
Her body trembled as she felt his touch, strong and strangely protective, her hands instinctively grabbed the young man’s robes, opening his cloak and revealing his broad, defined chest.
Her beautiful red eyes met his dark ones - piercing and magnetic, as if they were calling to her.
Her face flushed instantly.
"Feixue’er!" She was woken up by her brother’s voice and, with a cute little squeak, jumped out of Qingyi’s arms.
"Little sister, are you all right?" Tianran approached, grabbing her shoulders firmly.
"Ugh, I told you not to call me that!" Feixue raised her hand at Tianran, a loud slap echoing as he fell to the ground.
When her eyes met Qingyi’s again, she looked away and crossed her arms.

Qingyi examined her briefly, his eyes meeting her tight clothing, noting the patch of pale, perfect skin exposed on her thighs and waist before his gaze moved up to the young woman’s embarrassed, frowning face.
She was a small, slender woman, about one metre and fifty five tall, with little curves. He had to admit that she was one of the most adorable women he had ever seen.
"B-but little sister..." Tianran got up from the ground and practically crawled over to her. "How do you expect your big brother to protect you if the others don’t know I’m your big brother?"
The bright red mark from the slap covered his cheek, but he didn’t seem to care, his watery eyes were fixed on what he considered to be the most adorable creature in the world.
Qingyi couldn’t hold back a slight laugh when he saw that grown man, over thirty years old, talking to another grown woman as if she were a small child.
When he realized that they were both staring at him, he put his hands together before speaking: "I beg your pardon for my rather... impolite approach, young Miss Feixue."
He inclined his head, but received only an irritated grunt as she opened the carriage door.
"Ugh... whatever, just don’t disturb my beauty sleep anymore!" she closed the carriage door with a bang.
"I’m sorry about that, Qingyi. She’s a bit... complicated to deal with," explained Tianran.
"It’s okay." Qingyi shook his head.
He had dated someone with a similar temperament on earth and knew well the hell they could make of a man’s life.
’I even feel a little sorry for her future husband,’ Qingyi prepared to leave, but Mo Tianran’s voice stopped him.
"Wait, aren’t we going in the same direction? I can give you a ride to Golden Cloud City!"
"Hm..." Qingyi thought for a moment.
Visiting the Golden Cloud City wasn’t a bad idea.
There was no better place than big cities and important Sects to find beauties.
Besides, they were very close to the city - what would take hours on foot would take no more than forty minutes by carriage.
He nodded, and Tianran’s lips opened in a wide smile.
"Very well." Tianran opened the carriage door and looked at Feixue. "Little sister, can Qingyi come with us? It’ll be quick, I promise."
Hearing those words, the young redhead looked away.
Come with them? Did that mean she would be alone with Qingyi inside?
Her heart raced before she took a deep breath.
"All right, but if he dares to do anything funny, I’ll have Daddy castrate him," she hissed through her teeth, even though her eyes shone with anticipation as Qingyi approached.
"Thank you for your kindness, Lady Feixue," Qingyi said before getting into the carriage.
It was a closed and luxurious transport, with only one window in the entrance door, covered by a long silk veil.
As soon as he settled into the padded seat opposite Feixue, he noticed dozens of protection arrays and even noise suppression spells.
’They must be very rich...’ he concluded.
His master had taught him a little about arrays - not much, but enough to detect them instantly.
’But if they’re so wealthy... why do they travel without guards?’ he wondered, as his eyes fixed on Feixue’s small, delicate figure.
She kept her face turned away, seemingly staring into nothingness.
Occasionally, however, Qingyi would notice when her eyes subtly turned towards him before turning away again.
[Mo Feixue’s Lust increased by 5%].
[Mo Feixue’s Corruption increased by 2 points, +1 lust points].
’What? I didn’t even do anything!’ thought Qingyi, looking at that message before looking back at Feixue.
Her legs trembled slightly as she pressed them together, the blush on her face even more intense as her mind was lost in thoughts.
’Heavens... why can’t I marry him instead of that damned Yang?’ she lamented internally.
"Is everything all right, Miss Feixue? You seem anxious," he asked respectfully, making her shiver.
"Ah... I’m fine. It’s just that sitting all day in these tight things makes my legs a bit tense."
She laughed awkwardly as she saw Qingyi’s gaze travel down her exposed thighs.
"If you want a massage, my master taught me several massage techniques for relaxation." He forced a pure, gentle smile, as if he had no second thoughts.
Feixue froze when she heard those words.
A mixture of emotions took over her face - she seemed about to scold him, but when her eyes met his handsome face, she lost her nerve and looked away, embarrassed.
[Mo Feixue’s Corruption increased by 5 points, +1 lust points].
[Mo Feixue’s Lust increased by 15%].
"You can... if you want," she muttered, her mind buzzing as she raised her right leg towards Qingyi.
’Another golden opportunity!’ exulted the young man internally as he stretched out his hands to her small, delicate feet.
Carefully, he removed her pure white shoes. His fingers sank into the soft, silky skin as he caressed them.
[Tip: Your touch has aphrodisiac effects on women; injecting a little Qi increases the effect.]
Qingyi read that text and his smile widened even more as he set to work.
It was time to earn a fortune in lust points!

"I’ll talk to him... carry on without me."

Watching the subtle sway of Feiyan’s hips and the waves that spread across her plump ass as she walked, Qingyi sighed heavily.
"What’s wrong with that woman?" he muttered, his eyes focusing on the monk who had stayed behind, Ye Langtian.
The monk didn’t even seem to realize what had just happened and his palms were firmly pressed together as he prayed.
"There’s no need to worry about these two, Qingyi, they’ve always been like this." Langtian finally opened his eyes, revealing a serene and distant look.
"One wants the body, the other wants the gold. Perhaps it’s fate." He shook his head as he sipped from a glass of water on the table.
"Yes... some people are made for each other," Qingyi sighed, taking a sip of the tea and feeling the Qi spreading through his body.
Of course, that wouldn’t happen, at least not completely.

Suddenly, something came to his mind and he looked up, his curiosity aroused.
"He said that his older sister was an elder in the Sect... do you know anything about her?"

"Not much, but you shouldn’t worry about her. She exiled herself from the family after refusing a forced marriage. I doubt that she’s going to act for someone like Tianming."
"I see..." With nothing else to talk about, Qingyi focused on his meal.

[Feiyan’s Lust increased by 1%]
[Feiyan’s lust increased by 3%]
Just one touch on the feet was enough to increase Feixue’s lust by 10%. Why on earth was Feiyan’s so slow?

He finished his meal, paid and then left, walking back through the wide streets of the Golden Cloud City, Langtian’s voice sounding behind him.
"Be careful at the Sect test, Tianming is an impulsive idiot and I won’t be there to stop him."
Qingyi stopped for a brief moment, thanking the monk before continuing walking.
His eyes focused on the mountain on the horizon, the great walls that surrounded it and the pavilions and palaces that stretched on endlessly, like a celestial city.
’It must be a nice place to live...’ he looked up at the top of the mountain, covered in a thick layer of golden clouds.
That was probably the place where elders and core disciples lived, with the Sect leader standing high above them all.
He could only imagine the view from that place before coming back to reality, focusing his vision on the Thousand Petal Pavilion, filled with cultivators coming and going.
"The Sect selection test will be tomorrow morning... I’d better get ready," Qingyi muttered before hastening his pace, arriving at one of the service desks that had no line.
"Good morning, young master, what can I do for you?" The attendant greeted him, arranging some documents on the table.
"I need a high-quality cultivation room for the Qi refinement realm, I’ll be using it until dawn."
"Oh... preparing for the Ascending Dragon Sect selection, huh?" The attendant flashed a bright smile as she wrote something on a piece of paper.
"It’s fifty silver coins for the night in a high-quality cultivation room for the Qi refining realm, the room is number 98 on the second floor." She spoke, handing Qingyi a card.
"Thank you..." He paid with a gold coin, taking his change and the card before going up to the second floor and stopping in front of the cultivation room door.

He pressed the card against the lock and, after a few moments, the heavy doors opened to reveal a large room with completely black walls, lit only by Qi crystals that glowed with a strange blue light.
He entered the room, the door closing with a solid thud behind him.
Suddenly, he was cut off from the outside world, the noisy corridors seemed to have disappeared and he was left in absolute silence.
’Good sound insulation...’ he sat down in the center of the room, feeling the Qi around him explode in density.
After a short moment, it was already twenty times denser than outside.
Crossing his legs, he closed his eyes. It was time to start cultivating.

paragraphs: The air in the cultivation room trembled as sweat dripped incessantly down Long Qingyi’s bare chest, soaking his pants.
In his hands, a silver sword danced restlessly. Thunderous lightning surrounded it and the glow of the lightning sword’s Qi completely illuminated the room with every movement.
With each strike of the blade, small shockwaves swept through the air, scattering subtle electric rays that spread out like sparks, falling slowly.
Finally exhausted, Qingyi collapsed on his back, his breathing was heavy and irregular.
"System... how long?" he asked between gasps.
[This time, you lasted five minutes and thirty-nine seconds].
"Ah... that’s enough." A bitter smile appeared on his face. He was testing his new spiritual roots and the result was truly impressive.
What he was doing was called imbuing Qi, a technique that consisted of circulating energy not only through his body, but also through his weapons.
It was a simple and effective method, but with a huge energy cost, causing immense pressure on the meridians.

In the higher realms, this was no problem, but in the Qi Refinement Realm, it was rare for someone to be able to maintain this state for more than a few seconds before their meridians began to fatigue and suffer damage.
"What time is it?" Qingyi stood up with an exhausted grunt. He had trained enough, it was time to recover his Qi reserves.
"Right." Qingyi sheathed his sword as he sat down cross-legged.
Without further delay, he began to absorb the spiritual energy present in the room.
The night had been long and monotonous, but as soon as he immersed himself completely in the cultivation process, he lost all sense of time.
Only a loud knock on the large door of the room managed to snap him out of his trance.
Opening his eyes, he gathered his belongings, dressed quickly and opened the door.
"Good morning, young master, was your cultivation experience pleasant?" An attendant smiled warmly.
"It was... good." He returned the smile, taking a few silver coins from his pocket and offering them as a tip.
"Thank you very much for your preference, young cultivator," the attendant’s face lit up as she received the coins.
That amount represented more than three days of her salary!

"In case you’re in town for the Ascending Dragon Sect selection, I must remind you that it will start in approximately two hours." She spoke, her voice changing from a professional kindness to a real one.
Long Qingyi nodded and left the Thousand Petals Pavilion. Afterwards, he took a hot bath at a nearby inn and then enjoyed a hearty breakfast.
Feeling prepared, he set off in the direction of the imposing mountain that loomed on the horizon.
The streets were teeming with people, much more crowded than before, forcing him to squeeze through the crowd until he finally reached the Sect’s gates.

Internal disciples separated those taking part in the selection from those who just wanted to observe. Standing in the middle of the street, they projected their auras of the foundation realm onto the audience.
This was the first test - a test of will.
The candidates had to resist the spiritual pressure emanating from foundation stage cultivators and manage to get past them.
Many had already failed and dozens were lying in the streets as disciples dragged them out of the testing zone.
Some advanced with difficulty, dragging themselves along, while others passed without any problem, walking in large, relaxed strides.
Qingyi paused briefly, took a deep breath and stepped forward. Instantly, several powerful auras descended upon him.
But he remained unshaken. His face didn’t even twitch as he moved forward naturally, attracting impressed looks from everyone around him.
The inner disciples cleared the way, allowing him to pass through to the Sect entrance, where hundreds of candidates were already waiting.
"Oh... young master Qingyi!" A soft, seductive voice called out to him.
As he turned, he saw Feiyan running towards him, her voluptuous breasts almost escaping from her daring cleavage, boucing hypnotically with each hurried step.
Tianming followed right behind her. His face, initially smiling, contorted into a bitter frown when he noticed Qingyi’s presence.
But he didn’t say anything, just looked away disdainfully. He seemed to treat Qingyi like a mere insect that he would crush at the first opportunity.
"Good morning, Miss Feiyan." Qingyi smiled at her, feeling her sweet, mature fragrance envelop him.
"Oh... don’t call me Miss, you can call me Senior Sister Feiyan! We’ll soon be fellow disciples, right?" Feyian laughed lightly, her tone melodious and pleasant to hear.
"Oh... then I greet senior sister Feiyan!" Qingyi replied with a genuine laugh.
Feyian quickly wrapped her arm around his, pulling him close and pressing him against her voluptuous cleavage, her two bronze mountains of flesh shallowing his arm.
[Feiyan’s lust increased by 1%]
She felt a slight, strangely pleasant tremor run through her body as she touched Qingyi, but she kept her expression unchanged.
Qingyi could feel Tianming’s burning gaze on his back, like incandescent braziers, but he ignored it as he walked along with Feiyan.
"Has Junior Brother Qingyi just had a breakthrough?" She asked, also completely ignoring Tianming’s presence.
It was clear that she and the arrogant young master had had a rather serious conversation the night before.
"I can feel your Qi getting stronger... you seem to be only one step away from the seventh stage of Qi refinement." She turned her head.
"Yes... I ended up having a fortuitous encounter and making a lot of progress, hehehe." He smiled casually, scratching the back of his neck with his free hand.
"Oh... Junior Brother Qingyi is really impressive!" Her eyes shone brightly, but not in a pleasant way.
It was more like the hungry gaze of a snake that had just tracked down a helpless mouse.
She intensified her grip on his arm, wrapping him more tightly against her body, imprisoning him in a soft, warm sheet.
’That woman...’ Qingyi shook his head inwardly as he cast a quick glance at Tianming, who seemed about to explode.
His face was as red as a ripe tomato, his eyes completely filled with fury.
Honestly, it was a rather pathetic. Why on earth was a noble like Tianming so insistent on a plebeian woman who humiliated him like this?
[Feiyan’s lust increased by 1%]
’But I have to admit that she really knows how to play with a man’s heart.’ Qingyi repeated to himself as he felt the weight of her breasts, it was hard not to be conquered by that voluptuous body.
Shaking his head, he consulted her information screen.
’At least she doesn’t sleep with just anyone...’ He thought, Her chastity remained intact, meaning that no man had ever touched her.

chapters.title: Chapter 13 - The selection of the Ascending Dragon Sect (02)
paragraphs: "Attention!" A loud voice echoed, and all the participants in the selection fell silent.
Qingyi’s eyes immediately focused on the Sect’s gates. They were made of red marble, bordered with threads of pure gold, rising almost twenty meters high.
At the top stood an aged-looking man, wearing golden robes and caressing a long white beard that reached down to his chest.
Hua Feiyan shyly stepped away from Qingyi as the old man’s eyes swept the crowd. This was a Sect elder and she didn’t want to give him a bad impression.
"I’m Elder Tian from the Sect’s recruitment pavilion..." He spoke, his voice deep and authoritative.
His aura was so profound that not even those at the foundation realm could sense it.
’Iron body realm...’ Qingyi thought. It was the first time he had seen someone of such high cultivation.
He couldn’t feel the old man’s aura, but he could still perceive the air distorting around him, almost as if it were avoiding him.
"We have six hundred of you here today, those who have endured the auras of the inner disciples and proved themselves worthy of the next test." He paused, taking a deep breath before continuing.
"Of you, only fifty will be chosen. You will first take an affinity test and then a combat test against our outer disciples. The best will be selected."
He jumped from the top of the Sect gate. His fall speed was thunderous, but he landed without making a sound, his feet gently touching the ground.
Yet, in the next moment, the air around him was swept up in an explosion.
Dust rose, blowing off everyone’s clothes. Qingyi felt Feiyan’s delicate hands gripping him tightly as she pressed her body against his, as if seeking protection.
An smile played on Feiyan’s full, red lips as she turned her face to stare at Tianming. The Young master looked like he was about to explode.
She hadn’t managed to calm Tianming down yesterday and just ignored her words, but she wasn’t discouraged - she knew Xu Tianming very well.
He was temperamental, arrogant, jealous and, above all, he believed that she already belonged to him, and that no man other than him would ever be able to take her.
And that helped her. She knew all she had to do was keep teasing him, using Qingyi until Tianming exploded with jealousy.
This would be her chance to get back on his good side and once again receive all the pampering she deserved, and even more than that.
To Feiyan’s surprise, Tianming closed his eyes, gritted his teeth and his aura calmed down. When he opened them again, he didn’t even look at her, focusing his gaze on Elder Tian.
’So you’re trying to resist... huh?’ She smiled deviously.
"Senior Sister Feiyan... I don’t think that this is appropriate..." Qingyi said.
Her breasts were pressed firmly against his chest, and he was really fighting the urge to grab those two huge, soft mountains of bronze flesh.
But he held back.
Elder Tian was watching everyone coldly, and although he might have been able to ignore this temporary contact, Qingyi knew full well that maintaining that state for too long would lead to trouble.
"Oh... I’m sorry, Junior Brother Qingyi, I was just a little scared," she muttered, putting her fingers over her lips as she walked away.
Elder Tian’s loud voice caught their attention again.
"Line up behind the inner disciples. We’ll start the affinity test soon."
A group of inner disciples stopped in front of those who were there to take the test, and they all began to separate, forming a total of twelve rows of fifty each.
With everything organized, Elder Tian stepped onto the ground. A tremor spread before the ground broke, a towering pillar exploding from the earth, stretching more than ten meters high.
"This is a talent test pillar. It has a total of nine levels, the colors will display your spirit root and its level. Only those above level six will go on to the next part of the test."
Qingyi heard those words, but didn’t worry too much. He knew well that the judgment was different in cases like his lightning sword root.
It was too rare and was in no way below roots one or even two levels above his. So he was confident.
"The tests begin," the elder said, as the inner disciples organized their groups. The first to be tested took a hesitant step forward.
He appeared to be in his thirties, and his cultivation of the seventh stage of the Qi Refinement Realm was unimpressive for his age.

"Press your hands against the pillar." Elder Tian’s aged voice roused him from his thoughts. The man obeyed, pressing his hands against the pillar, which immediately blazed with flames as a few lights began to light up.
"Oh..." The man’s eyes twinkled, thinking he had succeeded, but the world of cultivation was cruel.
"Third level fire spirit root, failure." The elder’s voice wiped all the happiness from his face. He cast a pleading look as he prostrated himself on the ground.
"N-no, it can’t be! The oracle said I’d have good luck, there’s no way I can be-" The man’s voice ceased as Elder Tian’s aura fell over him. His knees gave way and he sank into the earth.
"You can question as much as you like," Elder Tian’s gaze swept over everyone there. His words were strong, but didn’t carry anger or any sign of offense.
"But make sure they are questions that deserve to be heard. The pillar doesn’t make mistakes. Keep quiet and simply leave if you fail," he concluded.
No one dared say a word.
Smiling, Elder Tian moved his hands and the man’s body was torn from the ground, flying for dozens of meters until it landed outside the testing zone.
No one knew if he was dead or alive, and no one dared to check it as long as Elder Tian was there.
"Next!" Elder Tian called out, his voice echoing through the tense silence that dominated the place.

He appeared to be in his thirties, and his cultivation of the seventh stage of the Qi Refinement Realm was unimpressive for his age.
"Press your hands against the pillar." Elder Tian’s aged voice roused him from his thoughts.
The man obeyed, pressing his hands against the pillar, which immediately blazed with flames as a few lights began to light up.
"Oh..." The man’s eyes twinkled, thinking he had succeeded, but the world of cultivation was cruel.
"Third level fire spirit root, failure." The elder’s voice wiped all the happiness from his face.
He cast a pleading look as he prostrated himself on the ground.
"N-no, it can’t be!
The oracle said I’d have good luck, there’s no way I can be-" The man’s voice ceased as Elder Tian’s aura fell over him.
His knees gave way and he sank into the earth.
"You can question as much as you like," Elder Tian’s gaze swept over everyone there.
His words were strong, but didn’t carry anger or any sign of offense.
"But make sure they are questions that deserve to be heard.
The pillar doesn’t make mistakes.
Keep quiet and simply leave if you fail," he concluded.
No one dared say a word.
Smiling, Elder Tian moved his hands and the man’s body was torn from the ground, flying for dozens of meters until it landed outside the testing zone.
No one knew if he was dead or alive, and no one dared to check it as long as Elder Tian was there.
"Next!" Elder Tian called out, his voice echoing through the tense silence that dominated the place.

chapters.title: Chapter 14 - The selection of the Ascending Dragon Sect (03)
paragraphs: The tests proceeded calmly after Elder Tian’s demonstration. No one dared question anything further.
Those who had passed gathered behind the elder, while those who had failed left with their heads down.
Some sniffled with tears in their eyes, others let long sighs escape, but all remained silent.
Soon, more than two hundred faced the test, but only forty passed.

"Next!" Elder Tian’s voice rang out, as a tanned beauty stepped forward with large steps, her fertile hips swaying in a smooth roll and the two large, plump masses of flesh that formed her perfect, heart-shaped ass jiggled with every step.
Qingyi had to admit, she was even more attractive from the back than she was from the front.

Stopping in front of the pillar, she gracefully raised her hand and touched the stone structure, which immediately shook. A vibrant brown aura spread and, in the next moment, seven lights lit up on the pillar.
"Seventh level earth spirit root, approved," the elder spoke, his eyes barely sweeping over Hua Feiyan’s body before calling for the next one.
Fifty more were called until Xu Tianming stepped forward. He seemed to have calmed his mind, but still flinched with anger whenever he noticed Qingyi’s gaze.
Stopping in front of the pillar, he took a slow breath and pressed his hand, releasing his Qi.
’This bastard had a breakthrough?’ Qingyi was taken aback.
He had felt Tianming’s Qi the day before, and he was a long way from being able to advance, with a very unstable base.
How on earth had this bastard stabilized his base and broken through in such a short space of time?
But then Qingyi remembered: Tianming was rich, filthy rich.
His family probably had a fortune so great that it would make even the Ascending Dragon Sect jealous.
’Ugh... damn rich bastards, using their wealth to take advantage of us lowly, unsupported cultivators!’
Fortunately, he didn’t have time to reflect on how absurd it was for him, of all people, to complain about wealth.
The pillar was surrounded by a silvery aura, trembling as the lights slowly came on.
Elder Tian’s eyebrows rose slightly, but soon a smile took over his face.
"As expected of Young Master Xu. Seventh level sword spirit root, approved."
As he joined the rest of the passers, Xu Tianming cast a teasing glance in Qingyi’s direction.
’Let’s see if this pretty face can beat that!’ Tianming thought, trying to force some confidence into his face.
He stood next to Feiyan, but she barely spared him a glance, which made his heart burn even more.
’Who the hell does this woman think she is to ignore me like that?’ He gritted his teeth, trying to control his murderous intent, but a little still leaked out, all focused on Qingyi.
’What a pathetic little man...’ Qingyi shook his head. That level of murderous intent was barely enough to touch his skin, but Elder Tian sensed it perfectly.
The old man’s eyes focused on Tianming for a few brief moments before he sighed. His expression looked disappointed as he called for the next person to be tested.
Soon, it was Qingyi’s turn.
He stood in front of the pillar and touched it lightly. A bluish light took over the structure, and exactly five lights came on.
Tianming’s eyes shone more brightly than ever, his body trembling as a triumphant smile dominated his face.
Elder Tian opened his mouth to give his verdict, but something changed. His aged eyes twitched slightly as he took a step closer.
From the blue aura surrounding the pillar, a silver one emerged, dancing before merging into a beautiful blue covered in silver threads. Sharp electric rays streaked violently through the air.
’A two-colored spirit root? No... it’s a lightning sword spirit root!’ The elder exhaled heavily.
In over hundred years of recruiting for the Sect, he had only seen two-colored spirit roots a handful of times, but fused spirit roots? It was unheard of for him.
He hesitated for a moment.
The requirements were sixth-level spirit roots as standard, but he couldn’t force himself to refuse that young man.
Raising the level of a spirit root was expensive, but it was still a possibility. The Sect had plenty of pills for that.
But a spiritual root base? That was almost impossible to change. If you were born with a bad element, you were probably doomed.

From the aura he sensed exuding from Qingyi’s body, he could already tell that, despite his level, his spiritual root power was no lower than a level seven. So the young man would probably have no problem standing out.
If he could cultivate well enough to obtain a spirit root enhancement pill... he would probably become part of the Sect’s backbone in the future.
"Fifth level lightning sword spirit root, approved," Elder Tian finally announced his decision.
Tianming’s face crumpled as he clenched his fists tightly.
Feiyan’s excited voice only made him even angrier. How could nothing go wrong for that bastard?
Why was the woman who was supposed to be his throwing herself into his arms like that?
"Junior Brother Qingyi really is amazing! It’s the first time I’ve seen a fused spirit root!" Feiyan smiled encouragingly at Qingyi.
She wanted to throw herself into his arms to stoke Tianming’s jealousy even more, but Elder Tian’s stern gaze made her abandon that idea.
"Don’t get too cocky, there’s still the combat test," Tianming growled between his teeth.
The rest of the tests were less exciting. Lots of failures and a few seventh level spirit roots, nothing more.
"Good," Elder Tian smiled as he looked at the crowd.
The numbers had dropped considerably - the six hundred who had passed the will test had been reduced to just one hundred and twenty.
The quality was lacking, but the numbers were acceptable.
"Follow me, we’re going to the Sect arena to start the combat test," Elder Tian’s voice echoed as he started walking.
Everyone had anxious and curious expressions on their faces as they entered the large central gate.
Even if they were rejected, just seeing the inside of the Sect would be enough for some there.

chapters.title: Chapter 15 - The selection of the Ascending Dragon Sect (04)
paragraphs: The arena for the ascending dragon sect’s outer disciples was huge, a white marble platform that stretched almost five hundred square meters, surrounded by a grandstand large enough to accommodate thousands.
"The last test for joining the Sect will be in individual combats against our outer disciples.

I don’t expect you to beat them, but I do expect you to give it your all. The fifty best among you will be chosen," Elder Tian announced, shifting his gaze to the outer disciples who would be testing the recruits.
There were about a hundred of them, and some would have to fight several battles to test all the candidates, but that was of little importance.
One of the outer disciples stepped forward, handing over a small booklet in which all the recruits wrote their names.
When everyone had finished, a space was opened up for battle.
"Hua Feiyan," the elder called out, and the bronze beauty stepped forward. A disciple of similar cultivation stood in front of her.
"Please... be gentle with me, senior..." she spoke, her voice seductive and drawling as she gave an arch salute.
Her cleavage opened even further, revealing the abundance of her full breasts, the mountains of soft flesh threatening to escape from the fabric.
The disciple froze. His eyes fixed on Feiyan’s torso, barely hearing Elder Tian’s order.
"Begin!"
A wicked smile appeared on Feiyan’s face as she moved, her earthy aura tearing through the air towards his chest.
"Shit!" The disciple barely managed to parry the first blow, Feiyan’s fist landing on his unprotected arm with a loud thud.
He felt his bones tremble and almost break under the impact. When he finally managed to circulate his Qi and defend his body, it was too late.
Feiyan’s fist hit his face, causing his nose to explode in blood as he fell backwards.
"This is cheating!" He roared, his eyes focusing on Elder Tian.
The elder just shook his head. He didn’t approve of what Feiyan had done, but he also needed to judge her fairly.

"In a real battle, a cultivator must use all his resources, even if they are... inadequate," the elder paused, his wrinkled expression showing disapproval. "Use this duel as an apprenticeship to reflect on your mistakes.
"I will learn, Elder Tian."
The disciple was not happy, but just bowed his head.
Elder Tian wouldn’t kill him like he did that random commoner, but being on his bad side would probably condemn him to something far worse than death.
The next tests after Feiyan were of little interest.
Recruits and mediocre disciples engaged in almost endless exchanges of blows until Elder Tian intervened or the recruit lost through exhaustion.
"It’s not even worth watching..." Qingyi said, closing his eyes and circulating his Qi. His attention was only caught when Tianming’s name echoed through the arena.
The young master of the Xu family walked forward, his silver robes with his family’s symbol fluttering in the wind.
Grabbing the blade at his waist, he drew it with one fluid movement, the sword Qi dancing like luminous serpents around the sharp edge.
"Come," he said contemptuously to the disciple who would test him, a burly young man of modest appearance.
Looking away, Tianming made sure that Feiyan was still watching him. He would show her how a real man fights.
"Begin!"
The moment the elder’s voice echoed, two powerful auras at the Qi Refinement Realm exploded.
The disciple was a fire cultivator; using a large axe, he roared as he swung it towards Tianming.
The young master turned his body elegantly, his blade striking his opponent’s with a metallic clang. They both took several steps back before facing each other again.
With each impact of their weapons, the air around them was swept away, the pressure of their cultivations making some weaker recruits instinctively retreat.
"You’re good!" The disciple roared, dragging his axe on the ground with a loud noise.
His flaming Qi flowed through the wooden handle, reaching the blackened blade and igniting it in an explosive blaze.
"I can’t say the same for you!" Young Master Tianming was not intimidated. The sword’s Qi glowed brighter than ever as he advanced.
A deafening bang echoed as their weapons met, the ground shaking slightly. Tianming had his teeth clenched, his muscles tensed to the limit as he pushed himself forward.
"Give way!" He ordered, his Qi exploding and throwing the outer disciple backwards.
His body collapsed onto the ground with a thud; he tried to get up, but shuddered, coughing up a trickle of blood.
Exhausted, Tianming fell to his knees and glanced in Feiyan’s direction, studying the young woman’s face for admiration.
’Have you seen how a real man fights? Swallow your foolish pride and agree to be my concubine!’
He repeated in his mind, his face filling with contempt as he looked at Qingyi. He was sure that pretty face would never be able to fight like him, a true warrior.

"That was a great demonstration, young master Xu, you’ll certainly reach great heights," Elder Tian praised him, but received nothing but a dissatisfied grunt as Tianming returned to his original position, staring at Feiyan like a dog in heat.
’Ah... a hopeless case,’ the old man sighed, but this was no time for such thoughts. Focusing his mind, he called out the next name.
"Long Qingyi, come forward."
Qingyi calmly walked forward, the thundercloud sword coming out of its scabbard with a sharp hiss.
The lightning sword’s aura danced tenuously around it, tiny electric threads spilling out onto the ground.
The disciple he would be fighting was also a sword user, a man of medium height and an ordinary face.
His spiritual root was wind, his clothes fluttering as he swung his sword around himself and the wind Qi spread through his body.
"Be careful, junior, I won’t take it easy on you." The disciple grinned.
"Please instruct me well, senior!" Qingyi gave a formal bow, his voice calm and humble, interrupted by Elder Tian’s order.
"Begin!"

chapters.title: Chapter 16 - The selection of the Ascending Dragon Sect (05)
paragraphs: Many held their breath as Qingyi released his full Qi, the subtle blue glow covered in silvery threads exploded, the runes running down the thundercloud sword’s blade pulsing intensely.
’I’ll end this with a single blow,’ Qingyi decided, stepping forward while swinging his sword.
The disciple didn’t flinch at the power of Qingyi’s aura.
He was at the seventh stage of the Qi Refinement Realm while Qingyi was only at the sixth. Even his spiritual root was of a higher level, so he wasn’t afraid.
Raising his sword, he parried Qingyi’s blow, but the next moment, he regretted it.
His arms trembled and he felt his Qi being suppressed.
Looking at his sword, his eyes widened. Qingyi’s blade was sunk into his, the metal melting like butter under the Qi surrounding the thundercloud sword.
Silence.
No one spoke a word as the melted tip of the sword fell to the ground with a metallic clang.
Qingyi just smiled slightly as he retracted his blade. He had expected it.
It was one of the biggest reasons why he preferred to try his luck with a fused bloodline instead of simply evolving his current one.
It was simply too broken!

The sword spirit root increased sharpness and strength to a level where Iron Body realm cultivators could even use their bare hands as swords, while the lightning spirit root added the destructive power that was lacking.
If that had been a human body instead of a sword, it would probably have been cut in half, and even if it hadn’t, all its meridians would have been destroyed by the lightning root.
Turning around, Qingyi saw Tianming’s fallen face, his mouth open as he tried to understand.
How on earth had he cut the sword of a higher level cultivator so easily?
’Calm down!’
Tianming lowered his head.
He still had a spiritual root of a much higher level than Qingyi’s and was two cultivation stages above, as well as being supported by a powerful family.
His gaze then flicked to Feiyan, who was smiling at Qingyi, as if he were her sun.
He was dumb, but not dumb enough to be unable to understand what she wanted, and that only made him despise himself even more.
Whenever his eyes fell on her body, any desire to move on disappeared. He just wanted to have her all to himself, for all eternity.
Why on earth couldn’t she just accept being a concubine? Why did she have to insist on becoming an official wife?
There would be no shortage of riches for her as a concubine. Did that damned wife status really make her go that far just to provoke him?
"It was quite a... demonstration," Elder Tian said, taking everyone’s attention.
He had to admit, fused spiritual roots were terrifying.
Even as a powerful Iron Body Realm expert, he still felt a slight threat from Qingyi’s blade.
It wasn’t something that could kill him, but it was certainly enough to draw blood.
"This humble one thanks Elder Tian for the compliment," Qingyi bowed respectfully to the elder before returning to his seat, ignoring the suppressed whispers among the recruits and disciples.
Soon, the tests began again, but they didn’t attract much attention from anyone. Mediocre disciples, no great talent revealed itself.
Only two other young people with seventh level spiritual roots managed to defeat the outer disciples, all the others ended in a draw or defeat for the recruits.
The separation wasn’t long either. The outer disciples gathered up those who had failed and led them out of the Sect. Soon, only fifty recruits remained.
Elder Tian stopped in front of the recruits, his eyes sweeping over everyone there before he let out a disappointed sigh.
This batch of recruits had been very disappointing. Even with a few surprises, it simply wasn’t enough.
There were about five young people with seventh-level spiritual roots. They were talented, but far from being true geniuses.
In all the previous selections, there was at least one disciple with eighth level spiritual roots, sometimes even ninth level roots.
But in this one, the most impressive thing he saw was Qingyi’s spirit root, which was only a fifth-level spirit root.
Regaining his composure, he waved his hands in the air as he stepped onto the arena floor. A marble table rose from the ground as fifty tokens appeared in the air, falling onto it.
They were wooden tokens, identical to each other, bearing the image of a dragon and a place for the disciple’s name, all with one exception, a golden token.
"These are your disciple tokens. As long as you are an outer disciple, they are everything to you.

If you lose them, the punishment will be severe. Without them, you won’t be able to go on missions, you won’t have access to the Sect’s facilities or receive your monthly salaries as disciples," Elder Tian explained, taking the golden token.

"This is the golden dragon token, given to disciples the Sect sees great potential in. By receiving this token, not only will they have a private residence, but they will also have twice the resources of ordinary outer disciples."
Elder Tian studied the features and emotions of each of the recruits with seventh level spiritual roots.
The only ones who stood out among them were Feiyan and Tianming. But neither of them pleased him.
Feiyan looked like a vile woman who would cling to any man, while Tianming was even worse.
A pathetic man, staring at a woman clearly uninterested in him like a dog in heat, unable to control his own murderous intent.
’The Xu family is lucky not to depend on this young man...’ he shook his head. The Xu family had many competent heirs and Tianming was far from the line of succession.

The mere fact that Tianming was from a family as powerful and with as much land as the Xu family would probably be enough for Elder Tian to choose him, but thinking about the young man’s personality, the old man hesitated.
His gaze swept over everyone there, until it stopped on Qingyi, one of the best surprises of this test.
He was an extremely handsome young man, but he didn’t show a hint of arrogance. His face was always calm, his smile always kind and his white clothes always immaculate.
Even when that lustful woman pushed herself against him, he didn’t show an ounce of lust.
’That’s what a true orthodox cultivator should be like... if his spiritual root was at least one level higher...’ Elder Tian gritted his teeth and, raising his gaze, made a decision.
"Long Qingyi, one step forward."

paragraphs: [Name: Long Qingyi
Age: 18
Cultivation: Sixth stage of the Qi Refinement Realm (14 lust points to improve)
Affinities: Lightning: 60 - Sword: 60 - Charm: 1000 (can be upgraded at the lust store)
Spiritual roots: Fifth level lightning sword root (100 lust points to upgrade, new roots can be bought in the lust store).
Bloodline: Blood of the dragon god of corruption (Common grade, 100 lust points to upgrade.)
Constitution: Body of the primordial dragon (Common grade, 100 lust points to improve)
Lust points: 700]
Long Qingyi found himself alone in his private cultivation room, his eyes firmly closed as he circulated his Qi.
Feeling ready, he looked at his status screen and clicked on improve cultivation. His muscles tightened and his dantian shuddered slightly before his body was filled with a pleasant freshness.
"System... what cultivation techniques do you recommend?"

[The system itself already functions as a cultivation technique. The host will benefit most from combat and movement techniques. Dual cultivation techniques would also be useful if the host is interested].
"For now I don’t think spending points on double cultivation is smart..." Qingyi shook his head, his eyes focusing on his current balance of lust points.
He had enough to buy a single combat or movement technique, but there would be nothing left to cultivate afterwards, and he didn’t know when Feiyan would be in his arms again.
He needed a new way to earn lust points if he really wanted to reach the foundation realm with a decent base in just five months.
With a sigh, he took out his golden token, inserted a small amount of Qi into it and checked his balance.
He had a total of five hundred Sect contribution points, just his monthly salary.

It was enough to cultivate non-stop for a few weeks in one of the Sect’s high-level cultivation rooms, but probably still not enough to form a decent base without evolving the level of his spiritual root.
But he couldn’t do that either. Elder Tian seemed to be keeping a close eye on his spiritual root, and if he evolved it without thinking, he could end up in trouble.
What was he supposed to say? That a miracle happened and his spirit root ended up evolving on its own?
"Come to think of it... that’s not a bad idea!" Qingyi’s eyes lit up.
This was a world of cultivation, he had lived here for twelve years. This kind of thing wasn’t common, but it happened often enough for thousands of stories to spread.
"Right, that’s what I’m going to do." He moved his fingers closer to the spiritual root enhancement button, but stopped when his gaze passed the bloodline and constitution tab.
Why hadn’t he thought of that? Bloodline and constitution also represented talent.
Even if they didn’t change your cultivation speed that much, they still meant huge leaps in power, to a level where cultivators could fight enemies whole realms above!

Of course, he was a long way from evolving his constitution and bloodline to that point. He would have to have them at least at mortal grade for that, and by the time they reached that level, his cultivation would already be so high that this kind of feat would be almost impossible.
"Problems for the future," he repeated in his mind.
The base power of his bloodline was already absurd enough that he was sure he would probably be able to fight weaker foundation realm cultivators, even if he was only at the common grade.
If he evolved it to the uncommon grade, he would probably even have a chance of victory.
"System, is that going to hurt?"
[Yes.]

"Ah... like everything on the path of cultivation." A bitter smile appeared on Qingyi’s face as he pressed on to evolve his bloodline and constitution at the same time, his lust points being reduced to 586.
[Initiating bloodline improvement...]
[Initiating constitution upgrade...]
Qingyi felt his blood burn, just as it had when his master had first passed on the bloodline to him. His eyes fluttered and he gritted his teeth.
In the next moment, his muscles ripped, his skin pulsed red and a stream of steam escaped through his lips. It was as if he was on fire.
His vision blurred and then blacked out as his eyes filled with blood. The pain was nowhere near as intense as what he felt when he received the bloodline, but it was much more despairing.
[Improved bloodline! Common grade -> Uncommon grade]
[Improved constitution! Common grade -> Uncommon grade]
[You have unlocked a new bloodline skill: Draconic Eyes (inferior)]
[A thread of draconic Qi awakens in your Dantian].
Qingyi’s eyes suddenly opened, a deep purple taking over his irises as his pupil took on a slit-like shape.
He looked around, seeing strange lines cutting through the air, like the flow of a river. As they reached the black walls of his cultivation room, they rebounded, their flow breaking.
The next moment, his eyes returned to normal and the lines disappeared.
"System... what the hell was that?" He asked, finally realizing the numerous notifications in front of him.
[Pure Qi.]
"Pure Qi?" Qingyi opened his mouth. Pure Qi was impossible to see, right? Not even draconic bloodlines should be able to perceive it.
The only visible Qi is that converted by the Dantian.

[Pure-blooded dragons have the innate ability to see pure Qi. Even the highest level draconic bloodlines have some level of impurity that keeps them human. This kind of impurity doesn’t exist in you].
"That... makes sense," Qingyi ducked his head. Bloodlines were strange things and he didn’t want to get a headache over it.
Closing his eyes, he felt the new thread of Qi in his dantian.
It was strange, hot and wild, but even so, it was easier to move than any other type of Qi he had ever come into contact with.
When he opened his eyes again, circulating that Qi through them, he saw the world around him change again, his pupils turning into bright purple slits.

"It’s incredible..." he muttered, moving his hand in front of his vision. He could perceive his internal flow of Qi clearly and, when he circulated it through his arm for an attack, he saw the pure energy shudder.
With that power, he could not only perceive his opponents’ Qi flow, but also predict their blows before they even fell.
After a few seconds, Qingyi stopped the circulation of Qi, feeling his eyes hurt. The draconic Qi put too great a strain on his meridians.

chapters.title: Chapter 26 - Lightning steps
paragraphs: [Movement technique: Lightning Steps
Rank: Rare
Description: A fast movement technique that hides the user in a cloud of electric sparks as they move forward.
Price: 500 lust points]
"Is that the best I can get?" Qingyi asked, frustrated.
He also wanted at least one combat technique, but his wealth simply wasn’t enough for that. A movement technique was the most he could get unless he was willing to use low-level techniques.
[Yes, I can show you a list of other similar techniques, but you won’t have as much affinity with any of them as you do with this one].
"Ah... I’ll stick with that one." Qingyi sighed, clicking the buy button. The next moment, an intense headache overtook him as he fell to his knees.
"Argh... does everything have to be painful like this?" He asked between his teeth, his breath panting as he assimilated the knowledge embedded in his head.
[Skipping the lengthy cultivation process comes at a great price.]
"It makes sense." A bitter smile appeared on Qingyi’s face as he stood up. He walked out of his residence, took a deep breath and planted his feet on the ground.
In the next moment, his body was seized by an electric cloud, as lightning raced down from his feet, tearing up the ground beneath him and hurling him forward.
In a fraction of a second, his body cut a space of twenty meters, hitting a tree and almost breaking it in half, the bang echoing through the Sect’s territory.
"Ugh... shit!" Qingyi coughed heavily as he leaned on the tree trunk.
’This is going to be harder than I thought. He stood up, planting his feet on the ground, before trying again.

This time, there was nothing to hit. His body was thrown forward in an explosion and his feet sank into the ground as he landed, tearing through the soft grass of his residence for more than five meters before finally coming to a stop.
"Elder Tian won’t be angry about this... will he?" Qingyi looked at the destroyed lawn. Well, it wasn’t his fault if his cultivation room was too small to train on it.
Shaking his head, he continued training.
On his third attempt, he almost succeeded, but his feet slipped and he ended up on his butt.
On his fourth, he lost his balance, rolled on the grass and ended up in the lake, his body sinking into the icy water.
"Crap!" He grunted as he climbed up the bank.

But it wasn’t all for nothing. As he fell into the water and tried desperately to activate the Lightning Steps, he felt a slight resistance, as if his body were floating on the water before falling completely.
Controlling his breathing, he tried again. His body exploded, hidden by a cloud of lightning and distorting with the movement as he appeared more than ten meters ahead.
In the split second before he landed, he used the Lightning Steps again, this time with less intensity. His feet seemed to float lightly on the grass, nullifying his inertia as he landed comfortably.
His eyes sparkled as he tried once more, but when it came time to land, he activated the Lightning Steps with maximum force.
His body was catapulted again several times until he felt his meridians begin to burn, landing more than five hundred meters from his home.
"That’s fucking great!" A big smile took over his face as he ran back. This time, his eyes focused on the lake.

Circulating his Qi and calming his internal energies, he launched himself towards the lake. His feet seemed to sink into the water, but soon he was moving forward again, the calm lake water shuddering as he landed on the other shore.
That was good, better than anything he had imagined, but it was still far from enough.
He still needed to be able to perfectly control the distance he would run and also maneuver in the middle of using the technique. If he didn’t, he would basically be useless in real combat.
Exhaling heavily, he bought a Qi refining pill and recovered his energy before starting to train again.

Over the next two weeks, he spent all of his five hundred Sect contribution points on pills and cultivation resources, training until his body collapsed from exhaustion before starting to spend his lust points.
Feiyan didn’t visit him once, but he didn’t care much. The journey of cultivation took a long time, and two weeks was nothing for beings who could live for centuries or millennia.

Stabilizing his cultivation, he sat, his eyes scanning his status screen. Feeling his cultivation base stabilize, he clicked forward, the power of the eighth stage of the Qi Refinement Realm flowing through his body.
"Ah... I really need a new source of lust points." He stood up with a pained grunt as he thought about what to do.
Maybe form a group and start doing missions for the Sect? That would be a good idea.
He could meet new girls, earn sect contribution points and get lust points at the same time.
As he was leaving his cultivation room, he heard a distant voice and his face lit up.
"Young Taoist Qingyi? Are you there? It’s Tianran." The chubby man shouted and soon the door to the residence opened, revealing a handsome, smiling young man.
"Brother Tianran, what brings you here?"
"Ah... nothing much! I was just passing through the Sect and remembered you, hehehe." Tianran laughed lightly. "I heard you were amazing, you even got a golden token!"
"It was luck," Qingyi replied humbly. "Would you like to come in? There’s some liquor if you need something to wet your throat."
"Ah... I’d love to, but I have things to sort out in the inner disciples’ area." Tianran took a small envelope out of his pocket and handed it to Qingyi.
"It’s an invitation to little sister’s wedding, it’s going to be in two weeks’ time. It would be great if you came along!"
"Oh... Thank you very much, Brother Tianran. I’ll do my best to be there!" Qingyi took the invitation, sealed by the Mo family symbol.
When Tianran left, he couldn’t help but give a sly smile.
There was a chance that it wouldn’t mean anything, but the solution to his lack of lust points had probably arrived!

After thinking for a moment, he decided that he would first go on a mission with the Sect. He needed to test his new movement technique in real combat, and a few extra Sect contribution points wouldn’t hurt.

In a fraction of a second, his body cut a space of twenty meters, hitting a tree and almost breaking it in half, the bang echoing through the Sect’s territory.
"Ugh... shit!" Qingyi coughed heavily as he leaned on the tree trunk.
’This is going to be harder than I thought.
He stood up, planting his feet on the ground, before trying again.
This time, there was nothing to hit.
His body was thrown forward in an explosion and his feet sank into the ground as he landed, tearing through the soft grass of his residence for more than five meters before finally coming to a stop.
"Elder Tian won’t be angry about this... will he?" Qingyi looked at the destroyed lawn.
Well, it wasn’t his fault if his cultivation room was too small to train on it.
Shaking his head, he continued training.
On his third attempt, he almost succeeded, but his feet slipped and he ended up on his butt.
On his fourth, he lost his balance, rolled on the grass and ended up in the lake, his body sinking into the icy water.
"Crap!" He grunted as he climbed up the bank.
But it wasn’t all for nothing.
As he fell into the water and tried desperately to activate the Lightning Steps, he felt a slight resistance, as if his body were floating on the water before falling completely.
Controlling his breathing, he tried again.
His body exploded, hidden by a cloud of lightning and distorting with the movement as he appeared more than ten meters ahead.
In the split second before he landed, he used the Lightning Steps again, this time with less intensity.
His feet seemed to float lightly on the grass, nullifying his inertia as he landed comfortably.
His eyes sparkled as he tried once more, but when it came time to land, he activated the Lightning Steps with maximum force.
His body was catapulted again several times until he felt his meridians begin to burn, landing more than five hundred meters from his home.
"That’s fucking great!" A big smile took over his face as he ran back.
This time, his eyes focused on the lake.
Circulating his Qi and calming his internal energies, he launched himself towards the lake.
His feet seemed to sink into the water, but soon he was moving forward again, the calm lake water shuddering as he landed on the other shore.
That was good, better than anything he had imagined, but it was still far from enough.
He still needed to be able to perfectly control the distance he would run and also maneuver in the middle of using the technique.
If he didn’t, he would basically be useless in real combat.
Exhaling heavily, he bought a Qi refining pill and recovered his energy before starting to train again.

Over the next two weeks, he spent all of his five hundred Sect contribution points on pills and cultivation resources, training until his body collapsed from exhaustion before starting to spend his lust points.
Feiyan didn’t visit him once, but he didn’t care much.
The journey of cultivation took a long time, and two weeks was nothing for beings who could live for centuries or millennia.
Stabilizing his cultivation, he sat, his eyes scanning his status screen.
Feeling his cultivation base stabilize, he clicked forward, the power of the eighth stage of the Qi Refinement Realm flowing through his body.
I really need a new source of lust points." He stood up with a pained grunt as he thought about what to do.
Maybe form a group and start doing missions for the Sect?
That would be a good idea.
He could meet new girls, earn sect contribution points and get lust points at the same time.
As he was leaving his cultivation room, he heard a distant voice and his face lit up.
"Young Taoist Qingyi?
Are you there?
It’s Tianran." The chubby man shouted and soon the door to the residence opened, revealing a handsome, smiling young man.
"Brother Tianran, what brings you here?"
"Ah... nothing much!
I was just passing through the Sect and remembered you, hehehe." Tianran laughed lightly.
"I heard you were amazing, you even got a golden token!"
"It was luck," Qingyi replied humbly.
"Would you like to come in?
There’s some liquor if you need something to wet your throat."
I’d love to, but I have things to sort out in the inner disciples’ area." Tianran took a small envelope out of his pocket and handed it to Qingyi.
"It’s an invitation to little sister’s wedding, it’s going to be in two weeks’ time.
It would be great if you came along!"
Thank you very much, Brother Tianran.
I’ll do my best to be there!" Qingyi took the invitation, sealed by the Mo family symbol.
When Tianran left, he couldn’t help but give a sly smile.
There was a chance that it wouldn’t mean anything, but the solution to his lack of lust points had probably arrived!
After thinking for a moment, he decided that he would first go on a mission with the Sect.
He needed to test his new movement technique in real combat, and a few extra Sect contribution points wouldn’t hurt.

chapters.title: Chapter 27 - The hunting mission
paragraphs: "Have you heard about the new disciple from the alchemy pavilion?"
"Hua Feiyan?"

"Yes, she managed to refine a pill to 70% purity on her first try! Madame Xue herself seems to have taken her as a core disciple. She hasn’t even reached the foundation realm yet and she’s already a core disciple!"
"I heard she was beautiful enough to compete among the sect’s three beauties!"
Qingyi listened to those rumors with a proud smile as he walked through the Sect.
The fortune he had spent on Feiyan had been worth it.
Even if her combat strength was lacking, her new talent with alchemy was probably enough to place her as one of the sect’s most important disciples.
She simply wouldn’t lack for cultivation resources.

"Ah... in the end it looks like I’m going to be the one who ends up being spoiled by her," he muttered, still remembering the excited smile and the warm, soft embrace of that voluptuous beauty when she received his gifts.
"I need a woman, and fast," he concluded, but quickly pushed those thoughts from his mind. He had endured twelve years without the touch of a woman, a few more weeks wouldn’t hurt.

Soon, he entered the Sect’s great mission hall, where dozens of disciples were staring at a large board with an endless list of missions. Some were as easy as delivering a letter to a nearby village, others required fighting spirit beasts and criminal groups.
Squeezing himself between the disciples, he began to look for any individual combat-related mission.
"Fellow disciple," a strong hand fell on his shoulder, and Qingyi turned around.
"Is there a problem?" He asked, his eyes scanning a rough-looking man. He was a little taller than Qingyi, with a powerful body and steady eyes.
"Well... we’re trying to get this mission, but we’re one short. What do you think about completing the group?" He showed Qingyi a piece of paper.

It was a combat mission classified as difficult, needing at least five disciples at the eighth stage of the Qi Refinement Realm. They needed to travel to a nearby village and kill a spirit beast at the seventh stage of the Qi Refinement Realm for the local baron. The prize was fat: a thousand Sect contribution points, two hundred each.
"When do you plan to leave for the mission?" Qingyi asked, looking at the time limit: 10 days, basically the time he needed before going to the wedding in the Yang family.
"Uh..." The man scratched his chin. "Right now, actually. We’re just waiting for someone to complete the group."
"Hm... right, I’ll go with you." Qingyi smiled, shaking the man’s hand. "I’m Long Qingyi."

"I’m Bao Zhang. Come on, I’ll introduce you to the rest of the group." Bao Zhang smiled, guiding Qingyi out of the Sect and onto the busy main street of Golden Cloud City. A wagon with three other Sect disciples was waiting for them.
"These are Lei Feng, Jun Hao and Chu Yang." Zhang pointed at each of the men.
"I’m Long Qingyi, please take care of me." Qingyi put his hands together, bowing his head respectfully.
He hated having to go back to being the calm, gentle and humble Qingyi, but that Qingyi gave him too many advantages to choose another face.
Lei Feng was playing with a small dagger, but the moment he heard that name, he raised his head. His eyes focused on Qingyi as he jumped off the wagon.
"That’s the guy I was talking about! The junior who got a golden token and Hua Feiyan was clinging to him throughout the test!" He smiled brightly, pointing at Qingyi as if he were a rare animal.
Jun Hao and Chu Yang, who seemed uninterested, finally noticed Qingyi’s presence.
Jun Hao, a chubby man with a friendly face, climbed down from the carriage with a grunt, stopping next to Qingyi and slapping him on the back.

"Fellow disciple... we have a lot to talk about... in detail, preferably... hehehe..." He spoke, his face red with lust, just like Lei Feng and Chu Yang. Their eyes watched Qingyi as if he were a national hero.
Hearing those words, Qingyi shuddered. ’This is going to be a long journey...’ He began to regret having joined the group.
"Get on the wagon if you don’t want to go running!" Bao Zhang roared, taking the driver’s seat.
Qingyi saw this as a way out, jumping onto the carriage with Jun Hao and Lei Feng running after him.
"So, senior brother Zhang, what kind of beast do we have to hunt exactly?" He asked, trying to get away from the three curious disciples.
Bao Zhang looked like a serious man, and at the first stage of the foundation realm, no one there interfered while he spoke.

"We don’t know much. It’s at the seventh or eighth Qi Refinement Realm. It seems to be some kind of giant wolf with horns, killed some farmers and now it seems to be attacking travelers going to Spirit Grass Village," Bao Zhang slapped the reins of the horse pulling the carriage.
"Hm... but we’re travelers going to the Spiritual Grass Village. Won’t we be attacked too?" Lei Feng asked, intruding on the conversation.
He was still curious about Qingyi’s relationship with Feiyan, but he was smart enough to notice Qingyi’s discomfort and not push it.
"Well, then we’ll finish the mission even faster! We won’t even need to look for the bastard!" Chu Yang replied confidently, but Bao Zhang only clucked his tongue.
"If the beast attacks us first, we’re dead. Fighting it without a trap is suicide." The group leader reached into one of his pockets and pulled out four small packets.
"These are essences to ward off beasts. We’ll use these until we set the trap." He distributed the packets to everyone.
Qingyi looked at the packet, holding it tightly.
Spirit beasts were really scary. His master had told him many stories about these creatures.
They were powerful - even the weakest ones were comparable to bloodline cultivators. It often took several other cultivators of the same level to suppress just one of them.
The most powerful ones could fight dozens or hundreds of cultivators of the same level, some with bodies that alone represented calamities.
’Ah... never mind, it’s still no match for my Corruption Dragon God bloodline or my Primordial Dragon constitution,’ Qingyi thought, injecting some confidence into his mind.
