chapters.title: Chapter 46 - Tang Yandu (01)
paragraphs: "I’m sorry master... but I’m not going to lose this time!" Tianming roared as he stood up.
Qingyi shuddered, backing away immediately.
What the hell was that bastard thinking of doing?
Even Elder Tian, who was about to proclaim Qingyi’s victory, froze, feeling the Qi around Tianming explode.
"Is that... demonic energy?" Qingyi’s eyes widened.
The Qi exuding from Tianming was dark and putrid, carrying a nauseating smell that immediately made his stomach turn.
His master had taught him to detect that kind of Qi very well.
"Today, you pay for everything you’ve made me suffer!" Tianming growled.

From his body, thousands of tiny needles came out, floating through the air, surrounding Qingyi completely. Each needle carried demonic and poisonous energy, powerful enough to kill cultivators of the Golden Core realm.
Qingyi felt his heart race and his blood run cold. He was exhausted, but still forced his body to move, taking staggering steps backwards.
This was dangerous.
Even if the poison and demonic energy didn’t affect him, the sheer quantity of needles was enough to easily kill him.
He looked around.
The needles formed a perfect dome. Even using lightning steps, he would still have to pass through dozens of them before he could escape.
He turned his face and his eyes met those of Hua Feiyan. The relief had been completely wiped from her beautiful face, replaced by a trembling expression of panic.
"Die!" Tianming roared as he closed his hands, and thousands of needles flew towards Qingyi.
"NO!" At the same time, Feiyan’s pained scream reached Qingyi’s ears, and he gritted his teeth.
Madame Xue stood next to her, her Iron Body Realm aura exploding, ready to stop Tianming right there.
But she stopped at the last moment.
Her chest sank as she looked at the stands.
There was a man in dark robes, watching Tianming with disappointed eyes.
He didn’t do anything, he didn’t even show any desire to act, but his presence alone caused both her and Elder Tianming to freeze.
"Let’s strengthen the arrays! Qingyi can take care of himself," she bit her thin lips, shouting at Elder Tian.
Qingyi also noticed the presence of the man in dark robes, but ignored it completely. For the first time since arriving in this world, he felt a real danger of death
But under Feiyan’s desperate gaze, he wouldn’t let himself be defeated so easily.
With a roar, he withdrew every last drop of draconic Qi from his Dantian, sending it all towards his eyes.
Crimson liquid flowed down his cheeks and dripped onto the ground, the purple of his pupils flickered slightly as he activated the lightning steps.
He only had one chance.
He moved all his Qi towards his right leg, feeling every muscle in his body tear and the sword of the thunderclouds shudder as he launched himself towards the dome of needles.
A thunderous explosion sounded as all the needles converged in his direction, and a cloud of greenish smoke rose as the needles that missed their target flew towards the stands.
Screams of horror echoed as they easily passed through the protective arrays.
Hundreds of disciples were hit, their bodies swelling with the poison as they agonized in pain.
"Hahaha..." a laugh escaped Tianming’s lips, soon turning into a crazed laughter.
"I killed you, you son of a bitch! See that? I killed you-" Tianming’s voice was interrupted when a figure broke through the clouds of black smoke.
"You talk too much!" Qingyi roared.
His Qi had already been completely depleted after breaking through the dome of needles, but his body continued forward.
With what little strength he had left, he raised his sword.
"I’m sorry, young man." A voice appeared in Qingyi’s mind and his body shook, stopping in mid-air.
In front of him stood the black-robed man, his handsome face showing a gentle smile as the thundercloud sword remained between his fingers.
"Unfortunately I can’t give you that pleasure." A metallic clang echoed as the thunderclouds sword shattered, it’s fragments falling to the ground as if they were glass.
with a subtle thrust of the man’s fingers, Qingyi was thrown dozens of meters, barely able to stand.
"You’re already dead, so do me a favor and fall down." The man turned towards Tianming and, at that moment, Qingyi realized.
There was a thin stream of blood coming from his forehead. Moving his fingers, he found a needle stuck between his eyes.
He was sure he had swept up all the needles. How could he have missed one? And why in such a vital spot?
Tears of blood ran down Qingyi’s eyes as he fell to his knees.
His mind became increasingly foggy, and he barely managed to see Feiyan’s desperate face one last time before his vision went completely blank.
"Master," Tianming also fell to his knees, prostrating himself before the man. "Forgive me for my mistake, I promise to do my best to make it up for it!"
"Don’t worry, it won’t be necessary," the man laughed, and Tianming raised his face with a faint glimmer of hope.
Would his master forgive him so easily?
Unfortunately, the glow didn’t last long. The next words from the man in the black robes made his blood run cold.
"Dead people don’t have to pay debts." The man only moved a single finger, and Tianming’s head was thrown into the air.
He personally liked Tianming, a young man with whom he truly shared many things in common.
Unfortunately, Tianming had crossed the line.
"DEVIL!" A roar echoed. Elder Tian finally reacted, but to no avail.
With a wave of the man’s hand, Elder Tian’s figure flew up, crashing into the arena wall with a violent thud.

"Ah... Since my position has already been revealed, I guess it’s okay to exterminate this miserable little place once and for all." The man’s body levitated slightly in the air, the space around him shaking as his Qi exploded.
He was ready to release all his Nascent Soul Realm cultivation when a cold, soft female voice reached him.
"Enough of your little games, Tang Yandu."
"Oh..." Tang Yandu’s face twisted into a bitter smile. "So little sister Biyue has finally found me."

chapters.title: Chapter 47 - Tang Yandu (02)
paragraphs: Yandu’s body fell to the ground. A single touch from Tang Biyue was enough to seal all of his cultivation.
The powerful aura surrounding the sect ceased, and the disciples still alive in the arena were finally able to breathe.
Their eyes fixed on the incomparable beauty in the center of the arena.
Some drooled, having never seen such a beautiful woman before, while others trembled with concern.
Who were these people? How could they be so powerful?
Biyue ignored the stares of the outer disciples. To her, they were nothing more than annoying and noisy ants.
Her beautiful green eyes focused on the man on the ground, her aura falling upon him and crushing him on the ground.
"Ugh... Do you have to be so cruel, little sister? It’s been so long since we’ve seen each other..." Yandu revealed a bloody smile.
"Don’t call me that, worm," Tang Biyue said, biting her lower lip in disgust. "You betrayed the family and the orthodox path, and you will pay for it."
"Oh... And you came here personally after some worm instead of sending one of Father’s shadows? I’m honored—" Yandu’s voice was cut off when Tang Biyue threw a needle toward his chest.
He choked slightly before his vision blurred and he fell to the ground.
Tang Biyue sighed heavily.
A pang of pain arose in her heart. That man was her older brother, and one of the people she loved most in her entire life.
Someone of her level would normally never stoop to walking with the lowly people of the outer regions, but she forced herself to do so.
If she let the family’s subordinates handle this, Yandu would be killed without even a chance for a trial.
She hated him for betraying everyone and giving himself over to the demonic path, but he was still her brother. She would be the one to present him to the patriarch.
"Look, it’s the sect leader!"
"Finally, we’re saved!"
Sighs of relief echoed among the outer disciples. On the horizon, a figure appeared.
It was a man in his sixties, his sharp face bearing signs of beauty worn away by time.
He wore a long red robe covered with images of golden dragons, his garments fluttering slightly as he descended toward the outer arena.
Under his feet was a sword surrounded by draconic patterns.
That was the sword of the ascending dragon, a flying weapon that belonged to the founder of the sect and one of the most powerful artifacts in the entire outer region of the blue moon continent.
Many held their breath as he stepped onto the arena floor.
They expected an epic battle, that their leader would push those people back to where they came from.
But that did not happen.
The sect leader fell to his knees and prostrated himself, his head hitting the ground like a servant bowing to an emperor.
"I greet the sovereign in my humble residence and beg for your mercy!" he said in a weak and submissive voice, his aura having completely disappeared.
Silence reigned among the disciples.
When their leader sent a stern glance out of the corner of his eye toward them, they began to prostrate themselves as well.
Even the injured Elder Tian moved, dragging himself with difficulty and prostrating himself before Tang Biyue.
Feiyan looked as if she was about to explode and rush towards Qingyi, but Madame Xue stopped her.
She grabbed the beauty’s neck, forcing her to prostrate herself as well and blocking her meridians to prevent her from doing anything foolish.
Tang Biyue swept everyone there with a cold, disinterested gaze.
There was nothing else to do, she could just leave, but her eyes met Qingyi’s figure and she stopped.
The young man was still on his knees, his eyes shining with a deep purple as blood trickled down his eyelids like an endless stream.
The glow in his eyes was beautiful and bewitching, but his consciousness seemed absent.
Tang Biyue shook her head slightly.
She knew that there was something wrong with Qingyi’s eyes from the moment she saw him, but she had never been able to identify exactly what it was.
At least not until now.
Under that gaze, she felt that every last drop of her being was being observed, all her secrets seemed to be revealed to him.
That was dangerous. Someone with such a high cultivation level as her should not feel this way.
She raised her hand. A pulsating green aura briefly appeared between her long, delicate fingers before fading away.
Killing him would be the best choice, but she couldn’t bring herself to do it. Her gaze wavered and her pale cheeks took on a rosy hue.
She remembered his touch and the sensation that had overwhelmed her body.
It was intense, something she had never felt before, but still, it was pleasant.
Her heart raced just remembering it.
Was it wrong to want more?
Looking toward the leader of the Ascending Dragon Sect, she said, "Your disciple will die if you don’t do anything."
No response.
The sect leader kept his face on the ground, not daring to lift even a single glance to admire that beauty.
"Ugh..." She grunted, she hated dealing with peasants because of that.
Tang Biyue hesitated for a moment, her body trembling slightly before finally walking towards Qingyi.
Her eyes swept over the destruction around her and the single needle stuck between his eyes.

That was the Tang family’s supreme technique, which only the most talented learned. Of course, that was an inferior version that her brother had modified to use demonic and poisonous Qi at the same time.
It was much weaker than the original, which could use millions of needles, but it was still powerful.
Qingyi surviving it was a miracle.
She crouched down and lightly touched Qingyi’s head before sending a small stream of Qi toward his head, a bloody needle falling to the ground.
Now, she just needed to stop his Qi circulation, and fast.
Fortunately, for someone from the rebirth realm, stopping Qingyi’s Qi circulation was as easy as crushing an ant.
A slight burst of Qi swept across the arena, and Qingyi’s body finally lost its stiffness. His eyes were closed, as he fell toward Tang Biyue.
The incomparable beauty shuddered as his head hit her cleavage, her huge breasts engulfing his face in a soft, warm embrace.
Her full lips parted in disgust, and she moved her hands to push Qingyi away, but she couldn’t.
She felt a shock run between her legs, forcing her to press them together tightly. "Mmph..." a moan almost escaped her lips.
What the hell was happening to her body? Why did she react like this to Qingyi’s touch?
She needed to know.
Gritting her teeth, she stood up, Qingyi’s body floating behind her alongside Tang Yandu’s.
With a single push, the three of them disappeared, leaving the arena completely empty.

He wore a long red robe covered with images of golden dragons, his garments fluttering slightly as he descended toward the outer arena.
Under his feet was a sword surrounded by draconic patterns.
That was the sword of the ascending dragon, a flying weapon that belonged to the founder of the sect and one of the most powerful artifacts in the entire outer region of the blue moon continent.
Many held their breath as he stepped onto the arena floor.
They expected an epic battle, that their leader would push those people back to where they came from.
But that did not happen.
The sect leader fell to his knees and prostrated himself, his head hitting the ground like a servant bowing to an emperor.
"I greet the sovereign in my humble residence and beg for your mercy!" he said in a weak and submissive voice, his aura having completely disappeared.
Silence reigned among the disciples.
When their leader sent a stern glance out of the corner of his eye toward them, they began to prostrate themselves as well.
Even the injured Elder Tian moved, dragging himself with difficulty and prostrating himself before Tang Biyue.
Feiyan looked as if she was about to explode and rush towards Qingyi, but Madame Xue stopped her.
She grabbed the beauty’s neck, forcing her to prostrate herself as well and blocking her meridians to prevent her from doing anything foolish.
Tang Biyue swept everyone there with a cold, disinterested gaze.
There was nothing else to do, she could just leave, but her eyes met Qingyi’s figure and she stopped.
The young man was still on his knees, his eyes shining with a deep purple as blood trickled down his eyelids like an endless stream.
The glow in his eyes was beautiful and bewitching, but his consciousness seemed absent.
Tang Biyue shook her head slightly.
She knew that there was something wrong with Qingyi’s eyes from the moment she saw him, but she had never been able to identify exactly what it was.
At least not until now.
Under that gaze, she felt that every last drop of her being was being observed, all her secrets seemed to be revealed to him.
That was dangerous.
Someone with such a high cultivation level as her should not feel this way.
She raised her hand.
A pulsating green aura briefly appeared between her long, delicate fingers before fading away.
Killing him would be the best choice, but she couldn’t bring herself to do it.
Her gaze wavered and her pale cheeks took on a rosy hue.
She remembered his touch and the sensation that had overwhelmed her body.
It was intense, something she had never felt before, but still, it was pleasant.
Her heart raced just remembering it.
Was it wrong to want more?
Looking toward the leader of the Ascending Dragon Sect, she said, "Your disciple will die if you don’t do anything."
No response.
The sect leader kept his face on the ground, not daring to lift even a single glance to admire that beauty.
"Ugh..." She grunted, she hated dealing with peasants because of that.
Tang Biyue hesitated for a moment, her body trembling slightly before finally walking towards Qingyi.
Her eyes swept over the destruction around her and the single needle stuck between his eyes.
That was the Tang family’s supreme technique, which only the most talented learned.
Of course, that was an inferior version that her brother had modified to use demonic and poisonous Qi at the same time.
It was much weaker than the original, which could use millions of needles, but it was still powerful.
Qingyi surviving it was a miracle.
She crouched down and lightly touched Qingyi’s head before sending a small stream of Qi toward his head, a bloody needle falling to the ground.
Now, she just needed to stop his Qi circulation, and fast.
Fortunately, for someone from the rebirth realm, stopping Qingyi’s Qi circulation was as easy as crushing an ant.
A slight burst of Qi swept across the arena, and Qingyi’s body finally lost its stiffness.
His eyes were closed, as he fell toward Tang Biyue.
The incomparable beauty shuddered as his head hit her cleavage, her huge breasts engulfing his face in a soft, warm embrace.
Her full lips parted in disgust, and she moved her hands to push Qingyi away, but she couldn’t.
She felt a shock run between her legs, forcing her to press them together tightly.
"Mmph..." a moan almost escaped her lips.
What the hell was happening to her body?
Why did she react like this to Qingyi’s touch?
She needed to know.
Gritting her teeth, she stood up, Qingyi’s body floating behind her alongside Tang Yandu’s.
With a single push, the three of them disappeared, leaving the arena completely empty.

chapters.title: Chapter 48 - Come with me
paragraphs: A small stone was thrown towards the face of a handsome young man.
"Ugh..." Qingyi grunted and his eyes fluttered slightly, but he didn’t get up. His mind was clouded, his body heavy, and his eyelids even more so.
It was only when a slightly larger stone hit him that he finally woke up.
"Fuck..." Qingyi opened his eyes, massaging his head painfully as he stood up.
He was in a dark room of a simple, rustic hut.
"Are you awake, princess?"
Qingyi heard a voice, soft and pleasant, indistinguishably male.
Another stone hit his head and he turned, his eyes meeting those of a man in handcuffs.
"You’re..." Qingyi’s eyes widened and the man smiled.
"Oh... so you remember me? I thought I was totally unconscious when my little sister showed up."
"The bastard who stopped me from killing that son of a bitch!"
The two of them spoke at the same time, and Tang Yandu’s face darkened.
"No... I mean, yes, but that’s not the point. I’m Tang Yandu!"
"Oh..." Qingyi scratched his chin, remembering the battle against Tianming.
He really didn’t remember anything after he broke through Tianming’s final technique.
That man had suddenly appeared, broken his sword and after that, darkness.
After thinking for a moment, something clicked in his mind and he looked up.
’Surname Tang... a poison cultivator... he said something about a little sister... could he be Tang Biyue’s brother?" Qingyi thought.
That was the best theory he could think of.
It all made sense, why on earth would such a high-level cultivator be in a miserable place like that?
If Tang Yandu was her brother, it would all be explained.
Feeling the Qi around him, he realized that Yandu’s cultivation had been sealed.
There was still a doubt in his chest.
Why on earth was he standing there, next to that man?
"Honestly... I don’t even know why Biyue bothered to save you and treat you so carefully." Yandu said.
"She even left her dear brother trapped with you, without a single way of protecting himself! Doesn’t that girl love me anymore?" He sniffled, his voice dramatic and tearful.
"Biyue?" Qingyi raised her face, feigning surprise.
"Yes, Tang Biyue, she’s my sister, the most talented cultivator in the Tang family in five thousand years.
The future of our family and one of the few cultivators in the whole world who has a chance of reaching the Transcendence Realm!"
Tang Yandu declared proudly, but paused for a moment, his eyes turning cold as he studied Qingyi.
"I wonder what she saw in you..." He turned his face away and Qingyi shuddered slightly.
Even with his cultivation sealed, Tang Yandu was still a Nascent Soul Realm cultivator.
A being so powerful that he could probably kill hundreds of cultivators like the leader of the Ascending Dragon Sect with a single thought.
His gaze carried an intense and natural pressure.
After a few moments watching Qingyi, Yandu’s face lit up.
Qingyi was a deadly handsome man, but he was sure that his little sister wouldn’t fall for something so simple.
After a moment’s thought, something finally dawned on him.
"You have a bloodline, don’t you? One that would make my little sister interested enough in you to interrupt her path just to study you."
Yandu’s words made Qingyi stand up abruptly. How the hell did he know?
’System... can they detect my lineage?’
[No, your lineage is totally hidden, that was probably just a clever guess]
Hearing the system’s words, Qingyi heaved a sigh of relief.
His lineage was not something very orthodox, and he would prefer that no one knew about it.
"Don’t be anxious about it, kid, it’s no big deal. My little sister herself has a bloodline!" Tang Yandu laughed.
"Uh?" Qingyi obviously already knew that, but had to feign surprise so as not to arouse any suspicion.
"Yes, the Emerald Abyss Winged Serpent Bloodline... is so powerful that she managed to kill an Iron Body Realm cultivator with a single blow while still in the Foundation Realm at the age of 11."
Those words shocked Qingyi.
Reaching the Foundation Realm at the age of 11 was already an absurd feat, but to kill an Iron Body Realm cultivate with that cultivation?
He had heard of people being able to cross entire realms, but to cross two realms and kill an opponent with a single blow was impossible to believe.
Even with poisonous Qi, that shouldn’t be possible.
Of course, Qingyi also had to take her cultivation into account.
With each realm, it became more and more difficult to cross stages and realms with pure combat power.
Now, she shouldn’t be able to face opponents more than three or four stages above her.
Something that was still almost unheard of for cultivators in the Rebirth Realm on the Blue Moon Continent, but which was, in a way, much more believable.
Thinking about his own power and the current power of his bloodline, Qingyi could only shudder.
How many levels of cultivation would he be able to cross if he raised it to mortal grade?
Tang Yandu noticed Qingyi’s face light up and his smile widened even more.
"I can teach you everything I know about lineages and constitutions, even help you awaken your true power..."
"And what do you want in return?" Qingyi asked, not in the least seduced by that proposal.
It was worth nothing to him, he had the system.
"Just release me, I have a technique that will allow you to release my sister’s seals, even with your miserable cultivation.
The moment I regain my power, I’ll get us both out of here. What do you think?" Tang Yandu explained, his face full of anticipation.
Qingyi seemed to think for a moment, but in the end just shook his head.
"No, I’m not as dumb as Tianming."
"Tianming was an idiot, of course, I killed him myself because of that! But you’re clever, you’re not going to force me to kill you, will you?"
Being ignored by Qingyi, a bit of urgency emerged in Yandu’s voice.
"I’m serious, I have secret manuals that I stole from my family. Do you know how much they’re worth?
You could buy an entire country with them in this miserable place! I’ll pass on all the knowledge I have!"
"That won’t be necessary." A voice echoed and a beauty with black hair and piercing green eyes entered the room.
Her voice was soft and cold, like the pleasant breeze of a spring morning.
Her beautiful eyes studied her brother with disappointment before focusing on Qingyi.
"Come with me."

chapters.title: Chapter 49 - Bloodline projection
paragraphs: Long Qingyi walked right behind Tang Biyue.
His face was anxious and his steps a little shaky as he watched her back.
His eyes briefly lowered.
From her delicate back to her waist so thin that he could almost encircle it with both hands, and then to her large hips and perfect, plump ass.
He quickly raised his face.
Unlike before, Tang Biyue was no longer hiding her Qi as she searched for her brother.
Her senses as a Rebirth Realm expert were unleashed to the full and the only reason Qingyi wasn’t being crushed by her Qi right now was because she was carefully controlling it.
Qingyi looked at the horizon.
From the top of the great mountain where they stood, he saw endless peaks rising up in a mountain range that seemed insurmountable.
He hesitated for a brief moment.
What on earth did that woman still want with him? Why had she brought him there?
"Are we in the basin of the nine peaks?" Qingyi finally asked, observing the mountain range.
It was exactly as described in some old books he had read in the sect.
An almost endless region, surrounded by a mountain range that could only be crossed by experts of the crystalline core realm.
The density of Qi was so high that cultivators from lower realms could have forced breakthroughs just by breathing it.
’No... the density of Qi is higher than in the sect, but it hasn’t changed that much. We must still be in the outer region of the continent.’ He thought.
"No," Tang Biyue replied coldly, guiding Qingyi to a small but luxurious pavilion at the top of the mountain.
It seemed to be where she was staying.
Halting her steps, she turned towards him.
"You could see it, couldn’t you? My real face?" She asked, her beautiful face coming closer to his.
Warm, sweet breath entered Qingyi’s nostrils, her lips opening in a gentle curve.
Qingyi shuddered at that question.
If he told the truth, she might kill him because she thought he had touched her intentionally, and lying in front of such an existence would be pointless.
After long moments of hesitation, he finally spoke.
"Y-yes. But it was a real accident! I didn’t mean to-"
Qingyi raised his hands protectively, but Tang Biyue didn’t seem to care, just shaking her head coldly.
Despite her coldness, Qingyi still noticed her cheeks turning a little pinker and her lips trembling slightly.
"That power in your eyes, use it again," she ordered, and Qingyi obeyed.
Closing his eyes, he felt his Dantian.
It was slightly different and the draconic Qi had not yet fully recovered, but it was enough.
When he opened his eyes again, they were a brilliant purple, and the world around him was filled with pure, dense Qi.
When his eyes met Tang Biyue’s, he shuddered.
The Qi inside her was so dense that it wasn’t just faint lines running through her meridians.
It seemed that her whole body was one giant meridian.
Just... how large were her Qi reserves?
"You can see the Qi moving, right?" She turned her face slightly, studying Qingyi’s eyes.
They were beautiful, but not only that.
She felt a tremor run through her soul realm and a slight discomfort in her chest, but not in an unpleasant way.
"Yes," Qingyi replied, and a faint smile played on Biyue’s lips.
It was exactly what she had imagined.
Extending her hand slightly, she moved her Qi to her fingertips.
"Tell me, what am I about to do?" she asked.
"Attack me."
"Yes." Biyue stopped her Qi circulation. "Now, try moving the Qi you used to activate this technique out of your body."
"Out of my body?" Qingyi blinked.
He had tried to move his draconic Qi out of his body many times, but it had never worked.
In fact, even moving his draconic Qi anywhere other than his Dantian or his eyes simply didn’t work.
The draconic Qi refused to move.
But... what if there was a different way of doing it?
Qingyi raised his face to Biyue, as if waiting for an explanation.
"There are many types of Qi."
"Some are natural, like pure Qi, which can only be seen by dragons, and Elemental Qi, which can be seen and felt by everyone, but only exists in specific places.
Others are innate in us, the one we are born with in our spiritual roots," Biyue paused slightly, catching her breath before continuing.
"So, we have lineage Qi. This isn’t ours."
She moved her hands in the air and the world around her shook as a greenish Qi that seemed to be made up of tiny crystals formed around her.
"This is the Qi that belongs to an ancestral being. With it comes extreme power and many abilities." The Qi of her bloodline spread through the air and Qingyi’s eyes widened.
He felt his heart tremble and his knees buckle from the pressure.
He couldn’t breathe.
"Among these abilities is lineage projection." The moment Biyue’s voice fell, Qingyi felt as if the world had ended.
The space around her collapsed, his vision distorting as an enormous figure rose from Biyue’s body.
It was a snake with emerald green eyes and crystal white scales.
Its head looked big enough to swallow an elephant as if it were a mouse, and its body stretched for hundreds of meters.
"That’s lineage projection, and that’s what I want you to do," Biyue spoke, but Qingyi could barely hear her.
His body was sunk up to his knees in the ground, his bones seemed to be broken.
He coughed up large gulps of blood.
That wasn’t even a fraction of the power of her bloodline. How the hell could it affect him that much?
"The name is lineage suppression. It is the greatest weapon of a cultivator who has lineage against one who does not.
Your constitution may allow you to kill enemies of much higher cultivation with one blow, but with lineage suppression, you can kill them without even touching them."
Tang Biyue knelt down in front of Qingyi, placing a healing pill in his mouth.

chapters.title: Chapter 50 - The first orgasm (R18)
paragraphs: "Ugh!" Qingyi sat down painfully as the effect of the healing pill spread through his body.
His broken bones went back into place, the blood dried up from his body and even his clothes were repaired.
All this without him moving a single thread of Qi.
Even the best healing pills in the sect didn’t have that powerful an effect.
"Stand up and show me your back," Tang Biyue ordered.
With a grunt, Qingyi stood up.
His body still ached a little, but he didn’t let it show.
He lifted his white robe, showing his broad back to Tang Biyue.
Tang Biyue trembled slightly, her face reddening as she moved her hands closer to Qingyi’s back.
"Don’t resist," she instructed.
Qingyi just nodded silently, feeling the slender, delicate fingers run along the muscles of his back, stopping just above his spine.
In the next moment, he felt a faint flow of Qi enter his skin and run through every part of his being.
Biyue’s beautiful face distorted slightly and she removed her hands from Qingyi’s body.
Her legs closed instinctively, and she felt a strange warmth creep up her groin, the beats in her chest accelerating.
This was exactly what she had felt before.
It was subtle.
Most women wouldn’t notice something like that, but Biyue’s cultivation and lineage made her very sensitive to such things.
Even the slightest imbalance in her body was clearly noticeable.
But she still couldn’t detect what had happened.
She didn’t feel any foreign energy or substance enter her body and with the brief scan she made on Qingyi, she didn’t feel anything.
His Qi was actually much purer than any Qi she had ever felt in her life.
How could this be possible?
Was Qingyi some kind of monk?
Perhaps it was a problem with her?
Tang Biyue was confused.
Biting her lower lip, she returned her hands to Qingyi’s back, her fingers pressing against his warm body.
Qingyi shivered slightly, feeling the breathing of the voluptuous beauty behind him quicken.
He had already realized that she was searching for something in his body, and he couldn’t help but shudder slightly as he remembered how his master treated that lineage.
It was an profane lineage, Qingyi didn’t deny that.
He knew full well that an expert like Biyue would probably kill him instantly if she discovered that lineage.
Even though the system claimed to be completely undetectable, he couldn’t help but feel anxious.
He had to find a way to escape from that place!
